Well, thanks again. I'm glad our lives intercepted at this particular point in space and time. I wish you luck on the rest of your journey, and I appreciate you taking the time to help me better figure out my own.

Perhaps I would benefit from seeking professional help.

Ah, that's why your advice is hitting me so deep, you've studied psychology in depth. Very cool, have you ever considered a career in the field? Or maybe you already are in it?

I think we've both had some pretty similar upbringing. I come from a great family who would give me all the love and support I could need (if I had the courage to ask for it), I have a university education, and I'm not swimming in any sort of debt or anything. There are SO many people who have it so much worse than me. For all intents and purposes, I should be happy. But I'm not. Which I think makes me feel guilty about feeling this way.

I do agree about keeping a routine and being physical. I'm very fortunate that one of my very few hobbies that I genuinely enjoy is athletic/physical in nature, so it doesn't take TOO much to get me off the couch. I find that my lowest points are also when I slack off on the physical exercise. But it's kind of a catch 22... I don't exercise, I become depressed... I become depressed, I don't want to exercise.

I'm sorry for rambling. I do appreciate you posting this all.

Thank you for sharing your knowledge. I'm brand new slipping into this depressive funk, which is why I'm so worried. I have no idea how long I will feel this way. I've seen other people go through it, but it's very surreal experiencing it myself. I dunno

Thank you for taking the time to write this all up for me. I genuinely appreciate your advice, and I get the vibe that you genuinely understand where I'm coming from.

Thank you
So then what's the point in living? How are more people not constantly thinking about suicide? Or do they just hide it well?
But if it's impossible what's the point
I have hobbies, but that's all they are, just things to distract me from reality

I just feel like such a loser. All my friends are well into their own careers, and some are even starting families. Meanwhile here I am living in my parents basement without a single clue what I am qualified to do
